title: Trump welcomes Mecca defence pact between Saudi, Pakistan, Turkey; says ‘shows how the Middle East is coming together’
content:
• The "Mecca Joint Defence Agreement" was recently signed by Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan.
• This three-way defence agreement was signed on 7 August in Mecca.
• A core provision of the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement states that an armed attack on any one of the three signatory countries would be considered an attack on all.

title: Iran's 134% food inflation bites hard: Meat, coffee and dairy quietly disappear from household tables
content:
• In July, Iran's food inflation reached 134% nationwide and 140% in rural areas, marking a sixth consecutive month of triple-digit annual food inflation.
• The Statistical Center of Iran (SCI) reported that the 12-month inflation rate for Iranian households was 66% for the year ending in July 2026, an increase from 62% in June, and described as the highest annual rate in decades.
• Annual dairy consumption in Iran significantly decreased from approximately 130 kilograms per person in 2010 to just 40 kilograms per person, as stated by Ali Ehsan Zafari, head of Iran's Dairy Cooperatives Union, on August 9.

title: India Q1 GDP growth seen at 7.3% as consumption, capex cushion Iran war shock: ET poll
content:
• India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth for Q1 FY27 is estimated at a median of 7.3% by an ET poll, while the RBI pegged the June quarter growth at 7%.
• The National Statistical Office (NSO) is scheduled to release the official GDP data for Q1 FY27 on August 31.
• The Centre's capital expenditure increased by 18.6% in Q1 FY27, compared with 9.1% in the previous quarter.

title: India opens tax amnesty scheme for small taxpayers to declare select foreign assets
content:
• The tax amnesty scheme for small taxpayers to declare foreign assets was announced by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman in the February 1 Budget.
• Taxpayers with undisclosed foreign income of up to Rs 1 crore can make a declaration under the scheme until December 31, 2026.
• Under the scheme, taxpayers will pay tax at 30% of the undisclosed income, along with an equal amount as penalty.

title: Centre to select first 50 airports under modified UDAN scheme
content:
• The modified UDAN scheme envisages the development of 100 airports and aerodromes over the next eight years, with an estimated capital outlay of ₹12,159 crore.
• The Centre has earmarked ₹3,661 crore for the construction of 200 helipads, primarily in hilly, island, remote and aspirational regions, under the modified UDAN scheme.
• The modified UDAN scheme provides ₹2,577 crore for operational and maintenance support for RCS-only airports for the first three years, capped at ₹3.06 crore annually per airport and ₹0.90 crore annually per heliport/water aerodrome, and includes a rule capping VAT on Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF) at a maximum of 1 per cent by State governments.

title: FinMin nudges ministries to switch to producer price index for rate adjustments in govt contracts
content:
• The Finance Ministry has urged all ministries and departments to switch from the Wholesale Price Index (WPI) to the Producer Price Index (PPI) for rate escalation and adjustment in future government procurement contracts.
• The Commerce Ministry began issuing monthly Producer Price Index (PPI) data for goods and services since June, with the aim of phasing out wholesale price inflation numbers in the next five years.
• In the output (goods) Producer Price Index (PPI), manufactured items hold the highest weight at 69.93%, followed by agriculture, forestry, and fishing at 22.16%, and electricity at 4.49%.

title: From farm to bottle: How agriculture powers India’s beverage economy
content:
• India's total horticulture production is estimated at 377.78 million tonnes for 2025-26, with fruit output at 121.48 million tonnes, as per the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare's Second Advance Estimates released in June this year.
• The government scheme 'Operation Greens' has expanded to cover 22 perishables, up from its initial focus on tomato, onion, and potato.
• India’s non-alcoholic beverages market was valued at $14.95 billion in 2024 and is projected to grow at 7.36% per year through 2030, according to the Ministry of Food Processing Industries.

title: Congress protests in Kalaburagi against ‘purification’ ritual at Kharge’s rally venue in Uttarakhand
content:
• Congress president and Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha, Mallikarjun Kharge, addressed a public meeting on August 8 at Ramlila Maidan in Haldwani, Uttarakhand.
• The Kalaburagi District Congress Committee staged a protest condemning an alleged ‘purification’ ritual performed at the Haldwani venue after Mallikarjun Kharge's rally.
• The Indian government has promised the Rajya Sabha that the allegation of a purification ritual after Mallikarjun Kharge's rally would be investigated.

title: Rejuvenation of irrigation channels, ponds to begin in Tamil Nadu under VB-G RAM G scheme
content:
• The rejuvenation of 10,185 irrigation channels and 809 ponds will commence in 37 districts of Tamil Nadu under the Viksit Bharat – Gramin Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (VB-G RAM G) scheme.
• The rejuvenation works under the VB-G RAM G scheme are scheduled to begin on August 17, 2026, at an estimated cost of ₹507.92 crore, with a target completion by September-end.
• N. Anand, the Minister for Rural Development and Water Resources, is scheduled to inaugurate the rejuvenation works in Tamil Nadu.

title: Olympics is always the biggest stage: Robles
content:
• Alvaro Robles, a Spanish table tennis player, has maintained a position inside the world's top 100 for 10 years and reached a career-high ranking of No. 28 before the Olympics.
• Robles has won a World Championship doubles silver medal and a European mixed doubles gold medal in his table tennis career.
• The Ultimate Table Tennis (UTT) league has significantly contributed to the growth of Indian table tennis, leading to many Indian players now ranking in the world's top 100, 50, and 40.
